title: Equipment Rental Checklist
subtitle: Capture asset number, component count, approved use, and condition photo; confirm custody and return.
description: Equipment Rental records asset number, component count, approved use, condition photo, custody, and return. Equipment Rental evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this equipment rental stage-gated verification when staff must document asset number and component count. Reconcile approved use, condition photo, custody, and return before the equipment rental handoff. Use the rental agreement reference, asset inventory, accessory checklist, condition photos, pickup receipt, custody transfer, damage ticket, return timestamp, and deposit disposition. This rental follows a portable asset by inventory class, serial identifier, accessory kit, pickup inspection, borrower custody, deposit disposition, damage charge, and physical return. Ask the assigned equipment rental reviewer to confirm asset number against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Equipment Rental starting details review
sections.guidance: List asset and component count, approved use, pickup condition photographs, custodian, deposit reference, damage route, return time, and final condition.

sections.title: Equipment Rental checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current equipment rental facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Equipment Rental required checks
items: Asset number is identified for this record
Component count matches the current request or source
Approved use is ready for point-of-use staff
Condition photo limits or questions are resolved
Custody is communicated to the responsible person
A changed equipment rental fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Equipment Rental failed or pending items

sections.title: Equipment Rental exception review and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold equipment rental readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Equipment Rental reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Equipment Rental receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
